title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.17955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Cla

translated_title: WebArena-Pro：一个面向Web智能体的异构、多模态、可复现基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型和视觉-语言模型的Web智能体正越来越多地被应用于涉及异构应用、多模态内容和有状态工作流的现实浏览器任务中。然而，现有的可复现Web智能体基准测试仅覆盖来自少数软件类别的少量Web应用，且模态仅限于文本和视觉。实时基准测试虽然扩大了站点覆盖范围，但由于页面和数据在运行之间会发生漂移，牺牲了可复现性。此外，现有基准测试未能有效评估智能体能否理解和使用嵌入在Web任务中的音频和视频内容。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了WebArena-Pro，这是一个包含300个任务的基准测试，涵盖六个领域类别中的20个自托管Web应用，跨越不同的界面惯例、工作流和数据模型。在所评估的智能体中，Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol 取得了最佳表现。
tldr: WebArena-Pro是一个涵盖20个自托管Web应用、300个任务的异构多模态可复现基准测试，首次支持对Web智能体理解和运用音频、视频内容能力的评估。
en_tdlr: WebArena-Pro is a heterogeneous, multimodal, reproducible benchmark with 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications, uniquely enabling evaluation of web agents on understanding and using audio and video content.
